description: This file implements a thread-safe in-memory session store with TTL and eviction policies, including classes for store statistics, custom error handling, and functions for store management.

classes.name: StoreStats
classes.description: A frozen dataclass representing a snapshot of store statistics, including session count, TTL, and max sessions.

classes.name: StoreKeyNotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when a session key is not found in the store.

classes.name: InMemorySessionStore
classes.description: A generic, thread-safe in-memory store for session data with TTL and eviction policies.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Create or replace a session value, enforcing deep copy for isolation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new session value; raises error if key exists.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a session value by key, returning a deep copy.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Remove all sessions and return the count of removed sessions.

methods.name: list_keys
methods.description: List session keys ordered by most recent access, limited by specified number.
